scope: Public-information match scouting, conservative Irelia sideboarding and field planning, native opponent integration, optional Mote review, and shared bot commands.

rust.scope: All 107 Cargo all-targets test harnesses, run with eight independent workers

python.scope: Full catalog/source tests on candidate v1; all Python tools, card data and source-manifest inputs are byte-identical in v2. Only match_ai.rs and its Rust integration tests changed.

native_interface.note: Three AI levels at two window sizes, each with and without captures; repeated render variants are not distinct simulated opponents. Each run plays a complete match and exercises optional sideboard advice, wake-from-rest, subsequent manual edits, field retirement, mulligans and concessions.

visual_review.findings: Sideboard advice fits its sidebar at both sizes. Review, undo and confirm controls remain separate and usable. Lobby policy explanation and completed match history are readable.

evaluation_plan.note: New seeds after one revision using the earlier 830000 cohort. Same four rival archetypes; not held-out matchup or human-strength validation. No further policy tuning on this cohort.

earlier_candidate.scope: Exploratory 16-pair cohort before one policy revision; not combined with the fresh-cohort result.
earlier_candidate.changes: Preserved Irelia core cards; stopped discounting broad staples for having multiple copies; capped total distance from the registered main deck; included buffs/equipment in Sunken Temple estimate.

rules_review.tournament_note: Hub still links the previously reviewed October 9 PDF; web tool rejects its 17.5MB body. Reused cached reviewed source and existing match validation; no new download claimed.
rules_review.scope: Public information boundary and registered sideboard legality; this is not a full-engine or full-gallery re-audit.
rules_review.finding_fixed: Initial scouting draft excluded game-end facedown reveals. CR422.4 requires them; scoring, concessions and agreed draws now record those legal reveals. In-progress private cards remain excluded.

limitations: This is a heuristic opponent, not established expert strength. The fresh comparison uses the same four rival archetypes with new seeds; it is not a held-out matchup or human-player evaluation.
Only the complete Arito registration is native-ready. Non-Arito benchmark rivals use their sourced main decks with authored empty sideboards and fields.
Both match policies still choose first. Scouting remembers distinct identities, not exact deck copy counts, and can miss information between snapshots or reveal forms outside the collector.
AI balance and Irelia core-preservation preferences are not extra rules on human sideboarding. Other sideboard roles are not inferred automatically.
Card coverage remains 466/1079 accepted legal identities, with 613 unavailable. Full Standard parity, full card support and expert AI remain unfinished.
No fresh independent Nix build in this batch; last accepted independent Nix source remains 6411bd141a3bff35eb6491e2a6202496045030bf.

retained_attempts.note: Old build/test pipeline intentionally terminated for the CR422.4 correction; not counted as final acceptance.
